messages:
ruth: Quick check  were rolling the mini webinar social push tomorrow. Need X teaser, LinkedIn long-thread, + short demo clip. Who can own copy + asset QA?
omar: I can draft copy. Need MP4 clip, transcript, and a thumbnail (16:9).
jin: Ill export the clip + transcript from events ops. @claire can you do the thumbnail + a 12s GIF? Deliver by 10:30 PT.
claire: Yep. Will produce 3 thumb sizes (16:9, 1:1, 4:5) + 12s GIF. PNG + MP4. Use brand palette v3.
ruth: Scheduling: X teaser 08:50 PT, LinkedIn thread 12:10 PT, clip follow-up +24h. OK?
omar: Works. Messaging decision: start with a benchmark stat or customer story? Benchmarks convert but need legal sign-off.
jin: Suggest backup copy: anonymized stat ("~2x inference cost reduction") + short customer line. If legal delays, remove numbers.
omar: Draft thread outline (dropping full copy by 07:45):
"Tweet 1: Hook  "Ship LLM features without the runaway bills.""
Tweet 2: Pain example
Tweet 3: Result  "~2x reduction in per-token cost" (anonymized)
Tweet 4: How  batching, quantization, KV cache
Tweet 5: CTA  rwd.in/miniweb"
claire: For LinkedIn I'll make a hero image with the anon stat callout and a speaker quote.
ruth: Routing: signups should tag SDR queue with "miniweb-slice". @jin confirm CRM UTM params for X vs LI?
jin: Confirmed: utm_source=social_x / utm_source=social_li. SDRs get a Slack ping + email digest.
omar: Engagement plan: reply to top 6 comments in first hour, pick top comment to amplify as a quote post. Who handles replies?
claire: I can triage for the first 30m then hand off to community.
post-bot: Draft posts queued: X (08:50 PT), LinkedIn (12:10 PT). Will auto-publish if approvals set by 07:30 PT.
ruth: Approval flow: omar -> jin -> legal (if numbers). If legal not back by 07:30, use quote-only copy.
omar: I'll do an A/B on the first hook (technical vs customer) and report in the postmortem.
jin: Assets will be uploaded to /shared/marketing/assets/miniweb-slice by 10:30 and I'll drop links here.
ruth: Post-launch metrics: CTR, signups, CPL, engagement rate. Quick sync tomorrow 09:45 PT for a 15m postmortem to iterate messaging.
omar: Copy will be in this thread for quick review. Tagging @jin @claire.
post-bot: Once approval=YES posts will go live at scheduled times"
